simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פִּתְגָּם (H6599) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פִּתְגָּם (pithgâm) means a (judicial) sentence First listed occurrence: Eccl 8 11.

definitions.full: H6599. pithgam מִּתְגָּם noun masculine edict, decree (Persian loan-word, Old Persian patigâma ( patigam , come to, arrive ), New Persian paigâm , message ; see Gildem ZKM iv. 214 Mey Entstehung 23 ; Aramaic מִּתְגָּמָא , word, command , Biblical Aramaic = Biblical Hebrew); — construct ׳פ הַטֶּלֶךְ Est 1:20 ; with Genitive object ׳פ הָרָעָה מַעֲשֵׂה Eccl 8:11 (apparently f., compare De; but Hi Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 115 read נַעֲשֶׂה for נַעֲשָׂה ).
